How Much Does a Custom Kitchen Cost in Tampa Bay in 2026?

Key takeaways

  • At PalmCraft, custom kitchens start from $10,000; the final number depends on your room, not on a catalog.
  • The biggest price drivers are the total length of cabinetry, door style, materials and finishes, and storage hardware.
  • A proper quote is itemized and given upfront, after a free measurement, so the price does not change during the project.

The short answer

There is no honest single price for a custom kitchen, because no two kitchens are the same size or built from the same materials. What we can say: PalmCraft custom kitchens start from $10,000, and most of the difference between one kitchen and another comes from a handful of choices you control.

The fastest way to get your real number is a free measurement and 3D design. You receive an itemized quote within 24 hours of the consultation, with no obligation.

What drives the price of custom cabinets

Custom cabinets are built to your walls, so the price follows what is actually built. These are the factors that move it the most:

  • Size: the total run of base, upper, and tall cabinets. A galley kitchen and a kitchen with an island and a pantry wall are very different projects.
  • Door style: American shaker or European flat-panel, including handleless designs.
  • Materials, colors, and finishes: painted, wood-grain, matte, or high-gloss surfaces each have their own cost.
  • Storage hardware: pull-outs, drawer organizers, hidden compartments, and soft-close systems.
  • Installation scope and site conditions: an empty new-build room is simpler than replacing an existing kitchen around plumbing and appliances.

Where homeowners overspend, and where they shouldn't save

Overspending usually happens on things you rarely touch: decorative extras that do not add storage. Saving in the wrong place usually means drawers and hardware that you use every day; those are the parts that wear first.

A good designer will show you both options in 3D so you can see what each choice changes before you pay for it.

Why buying from the maker changes the math

PalmCraft designs, builds, and installs cabinets in its own Oldsmar shop. There is no dealer markup between you and the people building your kitchen, and the same team answers for the design, production, and installation.

How payment works

The standard schedule is 50% to start production, 30% when cabinets are produced and ready for your inspection, and 20% after full delivery and installation. PalmCraft accepts credit card, Apple Pay, and ACH transfer.

Questions we hear often

Is the estimate free?

Yes. The in-home measurement, consultation, estimate, and 3D design are free and carry no obligation.

Can the price change after I sign?

The quote is itemized upfront. It changes only if you change the scope, for example by adding cabinets or switching materials.
